# VD-07 Wire-to-board connectors, pin headers and socket headers

This page is an excerpt of data that the vendors themselves publish (product pages, datasheets, drawings): the
board-side headers of several wire-to-board connector series, and pin and socket headers. The values are the vendors'
own, in the vendors' units; nothing is converted. "not published" marks a value that the vendor pages used for this
excerpt do not state. The page sets comparable parts side by side; it does not say which of them, if any, is on the
robot.
